text:
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear 
 the appropriate safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses,... 
 etc
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Environmental Precautions
Check oil level in compressor crank case but only with the compressor at rest, the oil level should never fall below the sight glass
Check for the unusual noises or vibrations.
Check for air leaks in piping and pipe connections.
Read and record pressure gauges and the compressor running time indicator.
Clean the compressor room floor.
